links.outcome: LLM prompting performance versus simple BoW and fine-tuned BioBERT baselines on same classification and reasoning data
links.effect: Fine-tuned BioBERT best (classification F1 0.800-0.902; reasoning 0.851). Best LLM few-shot CoT F1 0.671-0.770 and 0.682, comparable to BoW (0.602-0.753; 0.675). LLM took 78 h vs 0.078 h BioBERT and 0.008 h BoW.
links.quote: The simple BoW model performed similarly to the most complex LLM prompting.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (GPT-3.5, GPT-4) vs baseline NLP methods on biomedical literature classification and reasoning benchmark datasets without testing clinical deployment practices or guardrails.
